# Pinned IDNA inputs

The workspace URL-host converter follows the enabled lookup behavior of
libidn2 2.3.7 used by the pinned Curl 8.22.0 and Wget 1.25.0 profile. These
complete Unicode 15.0.0 inputs are independent of generated product tables:

| File | Official source | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `IdnaMappingTable.txt` | <https://www.unicode.org/Public/idna/15.0.0/IdnaMappingTable.txt> | `cc8522199541d60326a42a8f91f8748fd15630a42502dd2cf4878e81e2066ead` |
| `Idna2008.txt` | <https://www.unicode.org/Public/idna/idna2008derived/Idna2008-15.0.0.txt> | `210e9ca4941bc8632f326e61f95175387960685546c1db975c67ffb6788db2e0` |
| `UnicodeData.txt` | <https://www.unicode.org/Public/15.0.0/ucd/UnicodeData.txt> | `806e9aed65037197f1ec85e12be6e8cd870fc5608b4de0fffd990f689f376a73` |
| `DerivedJoiningType.txt` | <https://www.unicode.org/Public/15.0.0/ucd/extracted/DerivedJoiningType.txt> | `c4870b11e2b8b7d0eb70b99ce85608e5c28a399efa316cca97238a58ae160e5e` |
| `NormalizationTest.txt` | <https://www.unicode.org/Public/15.0.0/ucd/NormalizationTest.txt> | `fb9ac8cc154a80cad6caac9897af55a4e75176af6f4e2bb6edc2bf8b1d57f326` |

The original Unicode notices remain in the data; `LICENSE.txt` contains the
Unicode license. Run `MOON_HOME="$HOME/.moon-accounts/cli" moon run
tests/tools/idna.mbtx -- update` from the repository root to regenerate
`core/netops/idna_data.mbt`. `check` validates the same complete inputs and
compares the generated bytes. Regeneration is not execution evidence.
The independent 19,074-record normalization corpus checks the released NFC
primitive against every original column required by the Unicode NFC invariants;
its expected strings are never generated from the product converter.

The converter explicitly retains U+19DA as PVALID. Independent comparison of
all 1,114,112 codepoints against libidn2 2.3.7's release-generated `lib/data.c`
found this single category difference from the official derived file. The
release archive is <https://ftp.gnu.org/gnu/libidn/libidn2-2.3.7.tar.gz>, SHA-256
`4c21a791b610b9519b9d0e12b8097bf2f359b12f8dd92647611a929e6bfd7d64`;
the extracted data file has SHA-256
`0149b46c9b3bbecef1419abfa90d84c511fecbdff986f6a03a2c6eb891dd04f3`.

Released public normalization and Punycode primitives are used after fixed
mapping and admission. The private adapter retains whole-host transitional
retry, per-label bidi checks, ContextJ checks, the pinned CONTEXTO rule-presence
policy, and exact ACE/length restrictions. Updating Unicode data or replacing
this adapter requires fresh fixed-oracle evidence, including rejection and
cross-label fallback controls. No current publication acceptance is implied.
